# NewToSki

> > NewToSki is a comprehensive resource for beginner and intermediate skiers, offering equipment guides, technique tutorials, and curated gear from brands like Burton, Capita, Houdini, and Atomic.

Founded by Matthew and Katie Calderon, NewToSki has helped millions learn to ski confidently over 5 years with practical advice on everything from first-time ski trips to powder techniques. The site combines educational content with a shop featuring 383+ products including skis, snowboards, boots, and outerwear.

## Getting Started

- [Home - newtoski](https://newtoski.com): Homepage: guide to skiing with gear picks, beginner guides, and community
- [How To Ski: Ultimate Beginners Guide (10 Easy Steps) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-ski): Complete beginner tutorial: pizza stop, wedge turns, parallel skiing
- [FAQ - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/faq): FAQ help center covering gear, lessons, rentals, and first ski trips
- [About - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/about): Team intro for NewToSki covering snow sports with Matthew & Katie Calderon
- [About New To Ski - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/about-2): Mission statement: helping millions ski confidently for 5 years worldwide

## Shop & Products

- [Shop - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/shop): Main shop page with 383 ski products from Thule, Lange, Nordica, Rossignol
- [Best Sellers - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/best-sellers): Top products: Atomic boots, Burton Custom X, ski goggles and helmets
- [Skis - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/product-category/skis): Ski product catalog featuring Peak 98, SCOTT Superguide 95, Season Aero
- [Snowboards - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/product-category/snowboards): Snowboard catalog with Burton Custom X, Capita boards, and Scott Stevens
- [Apparel (Outerwear) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/product-category/apparel-outerwear): Outerwear catalog: Houdini, Norrona, Boulder Gear jackets and ski bibs

## Skiing Techniques

- [How To Ski Powder (Practical Tips for Beginners) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-ski-powder): Powder skiing guide: stance, weight distribution, and off-piste tips
- [How To Fall On Skis & NOT Hurt Yourself - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-fall-on-skis): Safety guide on falling technique and getting up after crashes
- [How To Get Up After a Ski Fall - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-get-up-after-ski-fall): Step-by-step fall recovery techniques for new skiers on slopes
- [How To Use Ski Lifts (Beginners Guide) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-use-ski-lifts): Lift tutorial: gondola, chair, t-bar, button, and magic carpet usage
- [How to Ski in a Whiteout with Zero Visibility - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-ski-whiteouts): Safety techniques for skiing in whiteout conditions with piste markers
- [How To Ski Backwards or Switch - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-ski-backward-or-switch): Tutorial on switch skiing technique and 180 spins for park tricks

## Gear & Equipment Guides

- [Guide To Buying Your First Ski Boot - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/ski-boot-buying-guide): First boot guide covering Mondopoint sizing, fit, and bootliner care
- [Mounting & Remounting Your Ski Bindings: FAQs - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/remounting-ski-bindings): Technical guide on ski binding mounting with 8mm spacing rules
- [Best Walkie Talkies for Skiing - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/best-ski-walkie-talkies): Review of Motorola, Dewalt, Midland two-way radios for mountain comms
- [How To Properly Wear Ski & Snow Pants With Boots? (Over or Under) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-wear-ski-pants-over-boots): Guide on wearing ski pants over boots with gaiters for waterproofing
- [How To Wash Ski Pants? (Without Damage) - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/how-to-wash-ski-pants): Care guide for washing nylon/polyester ski pants without damage

## Seasonal & Conditions Guides

- [Your Guide to Warm Weather or Spring Skiing 🍃☀ - newtoski](https://newtoski.com/warm-weather-skiing): Spring skiing tips for slushy conditions at Sierra Nevada, Val Thorens
